objective: First observed >=0.99 exact primary held-out accuracy; prioritize successful cells, then epochs
single_change: Multiply each task's native AdamW learning rate by 2; retain all other optimizer, schedule and model settings
screen_policy: Use original budgets and record every result. Proceed to all 75 short cells if coverage is at least baseline and most of the fully paired screen tasks have a lower three-seed median epoch ratio. Screen-only observations are never reported as suite improvements.
selection_policy: Choose using all 75 short cells: successful-cell coverage first, then paired per-task three-seed medians and worst cases. Report a geometric mean only if all 75 pairs pass. Keep all slower cells and censored failures visible.
long_policy: After fixing the selected configuration, run each of the 30 long baseline cells and 30 candidate cells once for a paired regression check. Do not change the selection based on long results.
validation: Original integrity/oracle tests; exact CPU baseline/factory checkpoint equivalence; CUDA capture neutrality, eager/native update equivalence, evaluation state preservation and resume-moment preservation
